prompt:
Create ONE horizontal 2D game terrain cutout on truly transparent background. Match the hand-painted underwater whale jaw-bone material in reference 1 and the bone-ridge style in reference 2. This is an asymmetrical long LOW CEILING / BROKEN JAW ARCH section for a side-view game, NOT a floating platform, not a mushroom cap and not a man-made slab.
Composition about 1800x850, whole piece contained with 8% transparent padding. A single contiguous solid mass of weathered cool ivory/grey-blue lamellar whale bone, with restrained faded coral-pink connective tissue in seams, a few attached barnacles, irregular scalloped edges. Broad curved horizontal striations should flow through the whole mass, with differing thickness at left and right, not rows of honeycomb holes. It reads as part of an enormous jaw/roof breaking across the chamber. The upper silhouette is uneven and gently climbing, the underside has shallow broad rounded breakage. No hanging narrow stem, spikes, teeth-like prongs, horizontal shelf lip or T-branch. Central 75% of visible width and 80% of visible height must be opaque: cavities are painted dark depressions only, no transparent holes through that core. Bottom remains substantial, not a thin ribbon. Muted diffuse upper-left underwater lighting, medium brush texture and clear shape at small runtime scale. No background water, floor, scenery, cast shadow, text, border, UI, red annotations, character, fish, door or separate objects. Generate only one complete organic ceiling piece.
